
# 步骤七 出行距离数据质量审计

## 7.1 检查原始数据和数值转换
```{r trip_distance_audit}
# 查看行程表规模
dim(trip)

# 检查 TRPMILES 字段类型
class(trip$TRPMILES) 

# 查看 TRPMILES 字段前10行数据
head(trip$TRPMILES, 10) 

# 统计原始取值种类
n_distinct(trip$TRPMILES) 

# 生成专门用于质量审计的数据
trip_audit <- trip %>%
  mutate(
    miles = parse_double(TRPMILES)
  )

# 查看转换后类型
class(trip_audit$miles)

# 查看数值摘要
summary(trip_audit$miles)

```

## 7.2 统计缺失、负数、零值和正值
```{r trip_distance_status}
# ==================================================
# Step 7.2 按数值类型进行全面检查
# ==================================================

trip_audit <- trip_audit %>%
  mutate(
    distance_status = case_when(
      is.na(TRPMILES) ~ "01_Raw missing",

      str_trim(TRPMILES) == "" ~ "02_Blank",

      is.na(miles) ~ "03_Parse failure",

      !is.finite(miles) ~ "04_Non-finite",

      miles < 0 ~ "05_Negative",

      miles == 0 ~ "06_Zero",

      miles > 0 ~ "07_Positive",

      TRUE ~ "08_Other"
    )
  )

# 汇总每种类型的记录数
distance_status_table <- trip_audit %>%
  count(distance_status, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = round(
      n / sum(n) * 100,
      2
    )
  )

print(distance_status_table)

# 检查分类是否覆盖全部记录
stopifnot(
  sum(distance_status_table$n) == nrow(trip_audit)
)

# 列出全部负数编码及出现次数
trip_audit %>%
  filter(distance_status == "05_Negative") %>%
  count(TRPMILES, sort = TRUE)

trip_audit %>%
  filter(
    distance_status %in% c(
      "02_Blank",
      "03_Parse failure",
      "04_Non-finite"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(TRPMILES, distance_status)

```
## 7.3 计算完整的距离描述性统计
```{r trip_distance_summary}
trip_nonnegative <- trip_audit %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(miles),
    miles >= 0
  )

distance_summary <- trip_nonnegative %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),

    minimum = min(miles),

    maximum = max(miles),

    mean = mean(miles),

    median = median(miles),

    sd = sd(miles),

    variance = var(miles),

    q01 = quantile(miles, 0.01),

    q05 = quantile(miles, 0.05),

    q25 = quantile(miles, 0.25),

    q75 = quantile(miles, 0.75),

    q90 = quantile(miles, 0.90),

    q95 = quantile(miles, 0.95),

    q99 = quantile(miles, 0.99)
  )

print(distance_summary)

# Mean 与 Median 的差异。
# 如果均值远大于中位数，往往意味着数据右偏，少量长距离行程对均值产生较大影响。

quantile(
  trip_nonnegative$miles,
  probs = c(
    0,
    0.01,
    0.05,
    0.10,
    0.25,
    0.50,
    0.75,
    0.90,
    0.95,
    0.99,
    0.999,
    1
  )
)


```

## 7.4 绘制出行距离分布图

图 1：完整非负距离分布
```{r trip_distance_histogram}

# ==================================================
# Step 7.4 数据可视化
# ==================================================

ggplot(
  trip_nonnegative,
  aes(x = miles)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 60,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Recorded Trip Distance",
    x = "Trip Distance (miles)",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

图 2：短距离区域的细节
```{r trip_distance_histogram_zoom}
ggplot(
  trip_nonnegative,
  aes(x = miles)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 2,
    boundary = 0,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(0, 100)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Trip Distance Distribution: 0–100 Miles",
    x = "Trip Distance (miles)",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

图 3：对数尺度的距离分布
```{r trip_distance_histogram_log}
ggplot(
  trip_nonnegative,
  aes(x = log1p(miles))
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 60,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Log-transformed Trip Distance",
    x = "log(1 + Trip Distance)",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```



## 7.5 检查极端距离及跨字段合理性

查看距离最大的记录
```{r trip_distance_extreme}
# ==================================================
# Step 7.5 极端观测及一致性核查
# ==================================================

trip_nonnegative %>%
  arrange(desc(miles)) %>%
  select(
    HOUSEID,
    PERSONID,
    TRIPID,
    TRPMILES,
    TRVLCMIN,
    TRIPMODE
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

```

查看零距离记录
```{r trip_distance_zero}
trip_audit %>%
  filter(
    distance_status == "06_Zero"
  ) %>%
  select(
    HOUSEID,
    PERSONID,
    TRIPID,
    TRPMILES,
    TRVLCMIN,
    TRIPMODE
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

# 首先将行程时间转换成数值：

trip_audit <- trip_audit %>%
  mutate(
    travel_minutes = parse_double(TRVLCMIN)
  )


# 接下来检查“距离为正，但记录的出行时间为 0”的行程：
trip_audit %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(miles),
    miles > 0,
    is.finite(travel_minutes),
    travel_minutes == 0
  ) %>%
  select(
    HOUSEID,
    PERSONID,
    TRIPID,
    miles,
    travel_minutes,
    TRIPMODE
  )

# 利用速度辅助识别可疑记录

trip_audit <- trip_audit %>%
  mutate(
    speed_mph = case_when(
      is.finite(miles) &
        miles >= 0 &
        is.finite(travel_minutes) &
        travel_minutes > 0 ~
          miles / (travel_minutes / 60),

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# 查看计算出的最高速度
trip_audit %>%
  filter(is.finite(speed_mph)) %>%
  arrange(desc(speed_mph)) %>%
  select(
    HOUSEID,
    PERSONID,
    TRIPID,
    miles,
    travel_minutes,
    speed_mph,
    TRIPMODE
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

```
